stories.title: Former senior police officer believes agent involved in Omagh bomb
stories.summary: Retired Ch Supt Norman Baxter was the Senior Investigating Officer (SIO) of the Omagh Bombing investigation from May 2002 until he retired in November 2008.

stories.title: Europe's security 'fundamentally reshaped' by war in Ukraine
stories.summary: Europe's security has been "fundamentally reshaped" by Russia's war in Ukraine, the taoiseach has said.

stories.title: McIlroy makes strong start in bid to equal Montgomerie's record
stories.summary: Rory McIlroy makes a strong start to his bid for a record-equalling eighth Race to Dubai title with a three under opening round at the DP World Tour Championship.

stories.title: Body 'kept in van for two weeks' before being moved to lough
stories.summary: Kenneth Lynch, 31, from Trasna Park in Enniskillen, was remanded in custody after appearing at Strabane Magistrates' Court via videolink.

stories.title: Former president of Athletics NI pleads guilty to child sex abuse charge
stories.summary: A former president of Athletics Northern Ireland has been put on the sex offenders register after pleading guilty to a child sex offence.

stories.title: CMAT joins Philomena Begley on stage in surprise appearance
stories.summary: Philomena Begley was honoured with the Lifetime Achievement Award in recognition of her 64-year career.

stories.title: Garth Brooks adds extra Belfast date as two shows sell out
stories.summary: Brooks will play three outdoor concerts at Boucher Road Playing Fields on 21 and 22 May 2027.

stories.title: I saved a stranger's life and my husband's at the same time
stories.summary: Una Brown had always said she would give a kidney to her husband Sean if the time came, and she did so in a roundabout way.

stories.title: Cost of Noah Donohoe inquest to public purse revealed
stories.summary: An inquest into the schoolboy's death faced numerous delays and overran initial estimates for its duration by several months.

stories.title: 'End of days' atmosphere at Stormont as party relationships deteriorate
stories.summary: Take Stormont, throw in a looming assembly election, add fresh rows over the Irish language and the ingredients for another Christmas crisis are all there.

stories.title: Police treating threatening email sent to more than 300 schools as 'hoax'
stories.summary: Police are conducting urgent enquiries, and liaising with schools - but the Department of Education urged schools to remain open.

stories.title: Man charged after unrest following visit from former US President Biden
stories.summary: Joe Biden was in Dublin to see his son Hunter awarded the Gold Medal for Outstanding Contribution for Public Discourse
